Outraged to discover that Ephram and Madison have gotten romantically involved, Dr. Brown almost terminates her job. However, Madison quits, leaving the Browns with an unhappy holiday.
Within an hour of the discovery that Amy has run away from home, the authorities are at the Abbott house to scour for clues and interview her devastated parents and brother.
Dr. Brown tries to intervene when a bulimic high school champion wrestler puts his life in jeopardy. Bright is suspended from school after he fights with Amy's boyfriend, Tommy.
Distracted by her first fight with Tommy, Amy forgets to prepare her father's birthday dinner. Madison lies to Ephram about liking a love song he wrote, leading to an argument.
Ephram gets the wrong idea when Madison tells him her roommate is going to be out of town. Meanwhile, Amy decides she's ready to have sex with Tommy.
Ephram is horrified and heartbroken after he tells Madison that he loves her, and she doesn't reciprocate. Meanwhile, Linda naïvely agrees to take care of Delia overnight.
Bright helps Ephram get a fake ID so he can get into a bar to see Madison perform. Meanwhile, Nina relies on Dr. Brown for emotional support after she is served with divorce papers.
Amy moves back home but finds adjusting to her old life difficult. Meanwhile, Ephram thinks Madison is going to break up with him. And Dr. Brown testifies on behalf of Nina.
Against Dr. Brown's judgment, Ephram and Madison decide that she should resume her job as Delia's babysitter. Meanwhile, Amy contemplates stopping her antidepressant medication.
Amy tells Bright that she may have developed feelings for Ephram. When Linda's HIV status is accidentally revealed to her patients, Dr. Abbott faces a potential malpractice suit.
Ephram and Amy go to the prom together as friends, but after seeing Madison, Amy realizes that Ephram's still brokenhearted and decides not to reveal her feelings for him.
When Amy accompanies Ephram to Boulder, a romantic moment leads her to confess her feelings for him. Meanwhile, Dr. Brown tries to convince his mentor to undergo a riskier surgery.
Ephram is accepted into Juilliard's summer program, and Dr. Abbott decides to open a bagel shop after losing his malpractice insurance. Dr. Brown has a revelation about his family.

El arma cae al piso y Mónica la toma para dispararle.
Amanda palidece al enterarse que César salió del peligro pero quedará paralítico.
Mientras se desnudan son espiados a la distancia.
Amanda, César y el hijo de ambos salen a comer unos hot dogs. En la acción, César niño desaparece.
Con la intención de evitar que Lucía huya, Amanda se esposa a ella.
Amanda y César se encuentran felices de poder disfrutar de su amor y haber recuperado el cariño del hijo de ambos.

Toro casi dispara a Miguel, pero llega Isadora con el maletín. Miguel se ofrece a abrirlo por temor a una bomba. Mientras tanto, un débil Rodolfo busca a Barbarita para llevarse a David y la espía con su bebé sin que ella lo note.

Pantoja vigila a Rodolfo augurándole años de cárcel. Mientras, Miguel y Barbarita se entregan al amor. Toña advierte a Clímaco que ayudar a Jéssica arruinará su futuro con Viviana, quien sufre al recordar que él no oyó lo de su embarazo.

Miguel culpa a Raimundo de la fuga de Rodolfo, y Ray jura que no sabe dónde está. Isadora llora al sentir una anomalía en sus dedos mientras toca el piano, y Emma la calma. Mientras, Rodolfo se oculta en un motel con Felicidad y David.

Caetano vende sus acciones para evitar la quiebra tras el desfalco de Rodolfo. Trinidad aconseja a Clímaco luchar por Viviana. Tibisay devuelve una joya a Caetano para sus deudas, y Moraima pide una cita a Rodolfo para darle su herencia.

Miguel, Yonjairo y Arturo exigen liberar a Moraima. Rodolfo acepta a cambio de huir sin rastreo y se despide de David con un cariño humano que asombra a Moraima. Caetano pide los ahorros a La Nena para salvar la empresa, enojando a Aníbal.

PlutoTVTrueCrime.us: A central California community is rocked when a pregnant wife vanishes without a trace on Christmas Eve.
A dedicated mother disappears from suburban Los Angeles, leaving behind three kids and a husband she planned to divorce.
When a Southern California high school teacher suddenly dies, it appears his death was due to natural causes.
When a chef’s wife goes missing from Southern California, it initially appears she may have voluntarily walked away from the life she knew.
For one week in 2016, Stefano Brizzi stored the body of a policeman in his flat in central London. Taking inspiration from the TV show Breaking Bad, he tried to dissolve the body in his bath tub.
On July 1st, 2000, eight-year-old Sarah Payne was snatched from the street in Littlehampton, West Sussex. She had been abducted and murdered by convicted paedophile Roy Whiting.
On December 1st, 1996, Tracie Andrews had stabbed her own fiancé Lee Harvey to death and was trying to get away with murder.
In 1988, Puente had drugged and killed her victims so she could continue to fraudulently claim their social security benefits.
Rodney Alcala appeared on The Dating Game and it led to his arrest. In 2011, he was found guilty of murdering six women and a twelve-year-old girl.
The murder of a beloved yoga instructor appears to be an open and shut robbery homicide until detectives find themselves deep in a murder investigation with one too many twists.
When a real estate entrepreneur is found in a pool of blood in his ransacked kitchen, investigators suspect a long-simmering family feud may be connected to his murder.
Five university students are brutally attacked and killed. As officers meticulously investigate the death scenes, they realize this is no average murderer. This killer knows how to cover his tracks.

In one violent evening, a series of bombs rock the sleepy California city of Fremont. The targets include both the Chief and Ex-Chief of police. Can authorities and forensic scientists stop the Fremont Bomber before he strikes again?
In August 1985, the fourteen-month killing spree of Richard Ramirez, known as the 'Night Stalker,' was ended after he claimed at least thirteen lives.
Serial killing partners Leonard Lake and Charles Ng murdered eleven people in California in the 1980s. They had a secret bunker where they raped and killed their prey.
The Sunderland Strangler, Steven Grieveson, killed four teenage boys in the early 90s.
Vince is a seasoned New Orleans sportscaster, and his marriage to the much younger Liz looks like a second chance for them both.
